name: Food Truck Headquarters USA
about:
Food Truck Headquarters USA operates from Clinton Township, Michigan, serving as an online specialist for food‑truck kitchen equipment and appliances. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The business stocks a curated selection of commercial‑grade equipment from brands such as Cookshack commercial smokers and Brood nitro coffee machines, targeting the specific spatial and power constraints of mobile and commissary kitchens. It functions as a distributor rather than a manufacturer, managing inventory, order fulfillment, and free shipping on most items, while explicitly stating it does not provide on‑site installation.

Its customer base consists of food‑truck entrepreneurs, food‑trailer and food‑cart operators, and commissary‑kitchen managers. The company’s educational content — covering topics from generator sizing to menu pricing — is aimed at both startup and established mobile‑food businesses across multiple states.

Food Truck Headquarters USA differentiates itself through hands‑on industry experience: its staff have built and operated food trucks, trailers, and commissary kitchens, allowing them to advise on equipment fit and functionality. The firm also publishes a library of how‑to guides and product comparisons to help buyers make informed purchasing decisions.
